response.sql: SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind

assumptions.assumption: A record is one advancedbehavior row. Only rows whose linked transaction record and trader both exist are counted (inner joins).
The share's denominator is the total of those joined rows across all trader types, so the shares sum to 1. Any rows with a NULL trader type form their own group and stay in the denominator.
